title: Juicy Light Brazilian Sea Bass Skewers
description: A flavorful and light Brazilian dish featuring sea bass, yuzu cure, and a blend of spices, perfect for a cozy dinner, and is also FODMAP friendly.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together yuzu juice, olive oil, garlic infused oil, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the sea bass cubes to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the marinated sea bass cubes onto the bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the fish is cooked through.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh parsley and lemon wedges.
Arrange the skewers on a lazy Susan spinner for easy serving.
Spin the lazy Susan to distribute the skewers evenly among the guests.
